identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a high-conversion, hands-free e-commerce platform that feels premium yet accessible, breaking the generic 'dropshipping site' mold.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, product names, and hero text. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for descriptions, prices, and UI elements. Normal tracking.

mono.usage: Use for order IDs, tracking numbers, and technical specs.

primary.name: Conversion Orange
primary.usage: Primary CTAs (Add to Cart, Checkout), Sale Badges, Price Highlights.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (2x standard). Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.

grid_system.hero: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Hero spans 8 cols, secondary spans 4.
grid_system.products: Dense Grid: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
grid_system.features: Asymmetric Grid: Alternating text/image layout with large negative space.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-900 font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-full transition-colors

cards.product: group relative bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1
cards.category: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl aspect-[4/5] group cursor-pointer

inputs.default: h-12 px-4 rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100 transition-all

visual_enhancers.radius: Rounded-xl (12px) for cards, Rounded-full for buttons
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle mesh gradients for hero backgrounds (Orange/Rose/Slate) at 5% opacity

media.image_style: Clean studio lighting, minimal background, high contrast product focus.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements (ring-2 ring-orange-500).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Hero section to showcase multiple categories at once.
Implement a 'Sticky' header with a prominent Search Bar (Amazon style).
Product Cards must focus on the Image first, then Price (Bold Orange), then Title.
Use 'Sonner' for all toast notifications (Add to Cart success, etc.).
Ensure the 'Checkout' flow is distraction-free (remove navigation, simple footer).
Use the provided image URLs for category placeholders.
Do NOT use generic 'Lorem Ipsum' - use realistic product names and descriptions.
For the 'Hands-Free' aspect, visualize the process with a simple 3-step diagram in the 'About' or 'How it Works' section.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Prioritize Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'Orange/Slate' theme.
